d:
Official video for the original single "Kaadhal Thozhi" by Vidya Vox.
Hi guys! So excited to be finally sharing this beautiful song with you! It's one of my all time favorite compositions of Shankar, and the lyrics beautifully written by Madan Karky. The song was inspired by the bullying & discrimination that I have witnessed some of my friends facing, purely on the basis of whom they loved. Some of my favorite Tamil lyrics translate to "We live on one Earth, under one sky, so all love is the same" - It doesn't matter who you love or where you are from, Love is love!
